digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Mpwakapwaka, Nchivuri)

teaser.en: Named for the deep shade it throws, this forest tree hides bright red fruits that are best admired and not eaten.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana na kivuli kizito unachotoa, na mti huu wa msituni huficha matunda mekundu yanayong'aa ambayo ni bora kuyatazama kuliko kuyala.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula chivuri-vuri chikulu unachohenda; muhi uhu wa tsakani unafwitsa matunda ga kundu ganagoala, ambago ni ga kulolwa tu, si ga kuriwa.

summary.en: *Nchivuri* is the triangle-tops, a broad shade tree of moist forest with red three-lobed fruits. Its red heartwood is used for building, furniture and canoes, and its roots as medicine.
summary.sw: *Nchivuri* ni mwakamwatu, mti mpana wa kivuli wa misitu yenye unyevu, wenye matunda mekundu yenye pande tatu. Kiini chake chekundu cha mbao hutumika kwa ujenzi, samani na mitumbwi, na mizizi yake kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Nchivuri* (kpwa Chingereza *triangle-tops*) ni muhi wa chivuri-vuri wenye dari pana, wa matsaka ga jeke-jeke, wenye matunda ga kundu ga mala mahahu. Chiiniche cha kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga, kuhenda fanicha na ngarawa, na miziye nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en:
*Nchivuri* is a shady tree with a dense, rounded crown that looks rather like a mango's from a distance. Its compound leaves have one to three pairs of leaflets, and new leaves flush pink-red before hardening to green.

The fruits are the giveaway: bright red, three-lobed capsules that split open to show shiny black seeds. They are striking, but the leaves and fruit are reported to be poisonous.
about.sw:
*Nchivuri* ni mti wa kivuli wenye taji nene la mviringo, linalofanana kidogo na la mwembe ukiliona kwa mbali. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko yenye jozi moja hadi tatu za vijani, na majani mapya huchipua yakiwa na rangi ya waridi-nyekundu kabla ya kukomaa na kuwa kijani.

Matunda ndiyo yanayoutambulisha: vifuko vyekundu vinavyong'aa, vyenye pande tatu, ambavyo hupasuka na kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi zinazong'aa. Yanavutia macho, lakini majani na matunda yanaripotiwa kuwa na sumu.
about.dg:
*Nchivuri* ni muhi wa chivuri-vuri wenye dari ya makodza manji na ya mviringo, inayoonekana chidide dza ya mwembe uchiilola kula kure. Makodzage ga kuungana gana makodza madide airi hadi sita, airi-airi, na makodza maphya ganatuluka ga rangi ya pinki na kundu kabla ya kukala magumu na ga chijani.

Matunda ndigo alamaye kulu: ni makakaya ga kundu ganagoala, ga mala mahahu, ganagoahuka na kuonyesa tembe nyiru zinazoala. Ni manono kulola, ela nkugombwa kukala makodza na matunda gana sumu.

where.en: It grows in moist evergreen forest, and in drier country it keeps to the banks of rivers and streams. Look for it when the red capsules are on the tree, or when a flush of pink new leaves lights up the crown.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu yenye unyevu ya kijani mwaka mzima, na katika maeneo makavu zaidi hushikilia kingo za mito na vijito. Utautafuta wakati vifuko vyekundu vimo mtini, au wakati machipukizi ya majani mapya ya waridi yanapong'arisha taji lake.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga jeke-jeke genye makodza chila wakati, na kpwenye tsi kavu zaidi unamera kanda-kanda ya miho mikulu na midide tu. Uhendze wakati makakaya ga kundu ganaphokala muhini, au wakati makodza maphya ga pinki ganaphoala dzulu ya dari.

uses.en: The red heartwood is used for building and furniture, and the trunks for poles and dugout canoes. The roots are used in traditional medicine, and the plant is also used to make soap.
uses.sw: Kiini chake chekundu cha mbao hutumika kwa ujenzi na samani, na mashina yake kwa nguzo na mitumbwi ya kuchongwa. Mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, na mmea huu pia hutumika kutengeneza sabuni.
uses.dg: Chiini cha kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga na kuhenda fanicha, na makolo nkuhumirwa dza nguzo na kuhenda ngarawa. Mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji, na mmea piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda sabuni.

culture.en: Its name speaks of shade: *nchivuri* comes from *chivurivuri*, 'shade', for its broad canopy. A tree like this is a natural place to rest out of the midday sun.
culture.sw: Jina lake linazungumzia kivuli: *nchivuri* linatokana na *chivurivuri*, 'kivuli', kwa sababu ya taji lake pana. Mti kama huu ni mahali pa kawaida pa kupumzika mbali na jua kali la mchana.
culture.dg: Dzinare rinagomba kuhusu chivuri-vuri: *nchivuri* rinalavywa kula *chivurivuri*, neno ra Chidigo ra pepho, kpwa sababu ya dariye pana. Muhi dza uhu ni phatu pha kawaida pha kuoya na kuhepa dzuwa ra namutsi.

names.en: The Digo name is *nchivuri*; it is also called *mpwakapwaka*. In Swahili it is *mwakamwatu*, and in English triangle-tops, after its three-cornered fruits. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mpwakapwaka* for this tree (*Blighia unijugata*) with the Swahili *mkukilemba* and *mwakamwatu*. Note that *mpwakapwaka* is also recorded as the Digo name of a different shrub, *Deinbollia borbonica*, in the same family.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *nchivuri*; pia huitwa *mpwakapwaka*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mwakamwatu*, na kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *triangle-tops*, kutokana na matunda yake yenye pembe tatu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mpwakapwaka* kwa mti huu (*Blighia unijugata*), pamoja na majina ya Kiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*. Ikumbukwe kwamba *mpwakapwaka* pia limerekodiwa kama jina la Kidigo la kichaka kingine, *Deinbollia borbonica*, cha familia hiyo hiyo.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *nchivuri*; piya unaihwa *mpwakapwaka*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwakamwatu*, na kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *triangle-tops*, kpwa sababu ya matundage genye pembe tahu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mpwakapwaka* kpwa muhi uhu (*Blighia unijugata*), phamwenga na madzina ga Chiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*. Manya kukala *mpwakapwaka* piya rikaandikpwa dza dzina ra Chidigo ra chitsaka chanjina, *Deinbollia borbonica*, cha jamii mwenga.

reason.en: Shares the name mpwakapwaka; also in the soapberry family
reason.sw: Wanashiriki jina *mpwakapwaka*; pia ni wa familia ya Sapindaceae (*soapberry*)
reason.dg: Chitsaka chenye dzina rimwenga, *mpwakapwaka*; piya cha jamii ya *soapberry*

reason.sw: *Lecaniodiscus*, mti mwingine wa msituni wa familia ya Sapindaceae
reason.dg: *Lecaniodiscus*, muhi wanjina wa tsakani wa jamii ya *soapberry*

reason.en: Also grows in moist and riverine forest
reason.sw: Nao huota katika misitu yenye unyevu na ya kando ya mito
reason.dg: Piya unamera kpwenye matsaka ga jeke-jeke na ga kanda-kanda ya miho

mgombato: mpwakapwaka (mi) type of plant (Blighia unijuguta; Lychee family); mkukilemba, mwakamwatu.
